AS000646 is a specific laboratory test code used within the Danish healthcare system's laboratory database to identify measurements of p-thyrotropin, also known as [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1]. This code is a key component of the technical reference framework for the national Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark (AFDK) program, which monitors the quality of care for atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. Specifically, AS000646 is utilized in "quality indicator 3" to track and verify that appropriate laboratory measurements are being conducted in connection with an atrial fibrillation diagnosis [^src1]. It is listed in the program's registry analysis documentation alongside a series of other specific codes used to identify relevant laboratory tests, echocardiograms, pharmacological treatments, and complication diagnoses across indicators 3 through 8 [^src1].
